banScoring: Enemy pick value plus current protection and future pick setup, minus own opportunity cost; bounded scenarios with schedule discount
synergy: Patch-filtered empirical pair results plus expert rules
carryDuel: Additional adjusted whole-game Carry-v-Carry weight: +0.8 for positive effects, +1.3 for negative effects
draftExplanation: Role- and spell-aware plans, conditional allied saves and potential item responses; mechanical adjustments affect indices, while the heuristic percentage scale is unchanged
roleModel: Curated flexes plus verified Slark mid / Undying support / Phoenix hard support; personal role confirmations remain supported

abilityRules.potentialItemScope: one next defensive branch per team, one protected target; unknown role build receives zero credit

economyModel: Role-aware farm demand, personal purchase ownership, build opportunity cost; no gold or GPM forecast

developmentModel.method: bounded expert item-plan context; candidate marginal contribution; final team contribution counted once
